lines.text: What if you woke up twice as big... every single day?
Day two. You're ten feet tall, and you weigh eight times more, because you grew in every direction. Your bed is history.
Day five. Eighty feet. Your bones start cracking under your own weight.
Day seven. Three hundred feet. You're taller than the Statue of Liberty.
Day ten. Half a mile. As tall as the tallest building on Earth.
Day fourteen. Eight miles. Your head is above the clouds, above Mount Everest, and you can barely breathe.
Day seventeen. Sixty-five miles. Your head is in outer space.
Day twenty-seven. Earth is the size of a soccer ball, and you're heavier than the whole planet. So now, Earth orbits you.
Day thirty-two. Your own gravity crushes you so hard that you ignite. You become a star.
So, what day would you stop? Tell me in the comments.
